name: core-calendar
description: Calendar and Holds on a table, D70 and D103's step 4, through the contract Supply: a booking whose Workflow is anchored on its status field holds time of a desk, a to-one relation, as it enters held, and commits it as it is booked; the desk's one place unavailable to a second booking of the slot, the second take deciding over the first; holdFor's rules (outside_hours, off_grid) through Holds' checkHold; findAvailability, an operation of the table as a whole, and its window; listBookings; the closures and hours the permission sets, a closure and a new zone refused over held time; the delete of a booking that waits for its committed time and of a desk that holds it; and each one's define refusals. Cases written by hand in the recorded format. Each answer holds what the replayer compares: a record's id, data and behaviors, an operation's result, a refusal whole, in the core's words; what only the engine's store answers (sequence numbers, versions, timestamps, the document a define echoes) is left out.
